sources.entry: Watcharr - Add and track all the shows and movies you are watching. Comes with user authentication, modern and clean UI and a very simple setup. MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Watcharr is a self-hosted watched list for tracking movies, TV shows and anime, with ratings and viewing status, built with Go and Svelte(Kit).
summary.what_it_does: Lets you add and track movies and TV shows (including anime) you have watched, are watching, or plan to watch, and rate them and set their status. The README says that with extra configuration it can also track video games. It includes user authentication with separate user profiles, and a Discover section for browsing content. The backend is written in Go and the frontend uses Svelte(Kit). A public demo instance is available, which runs the latest dev build and may contain bugs. Setup is documented separately, and the README points to a docker-compose.yml file as the quick route.
use_cases: track movies and shows I have watched
keep a watchlist of planned shows
rate and log anime I am watching
track video game progress with extra configuration
run a private watched list with user logins
how_to_run: Follow the documentation site setup guide (linked from the README)
Optionally use the docker-compose.yml file referenced in the README
notable: Tracks movies, TV shows and anime with ratings and status such as watched, watching and planned
Video game tracking possible with extra configuration
Built-in user authentication with multiple user accounts
Community Kodi plugin for automatically tracking watched shows and movies
Public demo instance available for testing
caveats: Video game tracking requires extra configuration
Demo instance runs the unstable dev build and may have bugs
Community-made tools are not maintained or vetted by the project
